· [?] · the switch is in the register
shhh config · project file · .shhh/config.toml
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

…
❯ permission mode    ⏵⏵ auto — edits apply; allowlisted commands run                                                        global
↓ 13 more

[↑↓/jk] move between settings
[enter] open the setting under the pointer, and take what is in it
[/] filter the settings by name
[backspace] delete a character from the filter or the field being typed into
[ctrl+r] reset this setting to its default
[ctrl+s] write every staged change to the project file, .shhh/config.toml
[shift+tab] switch the write between the project file and the global one
[esc] clear the filter, then close it
[esc] back — leaves the picker, or the screen, writing nothing

glyphs
⚙  a read: a file, a search, a listing
$  a shell command
✎  an edit, a write, a patch or a memory
◇  a sub-agent
⇄  a call to a server not marked read-only
✻  the model writing its calls, counted as they arrive
⛁  a published report page
≡  a reading of the session
✓  a compaction that brought the window back
·  accepted or not reached yet
▸  running
✦  the classifier is deciding
✓  a check passed, a turn or a compaction came out well
∗  a turn's close
✗  failed
⊘  refused or turned off: dim by you, red by a rule
■  stopped by you while it ran
⚠  stalled, paused, blocked, or waiting on you
↺  picked up from a checkpoint
—  nothing was kept to say
[?] hide the keys
